rows.title: Review: In ‘Bridge of Spies,’ Spielberg Considers the Cold War
rows.dek_lead: In “Bridge of Spies,” a gravely moody, perfectly directed thriller, Steven Spielberg returns you to the good old bad days of the Cold War and its great fictions, with their bottomless political chasms and moral gray areas.
